title: VesposLocalTrims
description: Allows the player to locally load and change their armor trims client sided.
body:
# About VesposLocalTrims

Allows the player to locally load and change their armor trims client sided.

# How to use

The default bind for toggling the ui is **Y**.
The bind is changable in the keybinds menu in the minecraft settings.

just use the arrows to switch trims and ignot, and upon completion with your trimset make sure "override" (the button uptop) is enabled, and then click on the save button

# How to use configs

Once finished making your trimset, you may click on the "Save Pattern config", and then choose a name and click on save. this will upload a config .json file of your trimset to .minecraft\config\VesposLocalTrims.

To load a config, click on the "Load Config" button in the ui, and then you will see a list of your existing configs. to use one, just click on the "Load" button of the config you wish to use and just click save.
